description: Detect suppliers that bill on a monthly cadence and report months with no voucher. A subscription that appears in March, April and June but not May almost always means a receipt was never entered. Read-only.

from.description: Start of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

minMonths.description: How many distinct months a supplier needs before it counts as recurring (default 3).

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

name: sevdesk_subscription_gaps
title: Find gaps in recurring supplier charges
